name: Jury
source:
Jury AVN is an adult, erotic story based game containing high resolution rendered images and movies!

The game tracks you as the main character being called up for a high profile trial as a member of the jury.
Brooke Lafferty (American actress, model and franchise) has been accused of murdering her equally famous husband.
How the trial pans out is down to you as the player.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2258290/Jury__Episode_1_Before_the_Trial/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
Jury AVN是一款基于成人色情故事的游戏，包含高分辨率渲染图像和电影！

游戏以你为主角，作为陪审团成员被征召参加备受瞩目的审判。
布鲁克·拉弗蒂（美国女演员、模特和特许经营商）被指控谋杀了她同样著名的丈夫。
审判的结果如何取决于作为玩家的你。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2258290/Jury__Episode_1_Before_the_Trial/]Steam[/url]]
